evidence_notes: Historical Build #84/#136 had no UnifiedCaptureOwner; #193 implemented shared capture owner; #228 no isSessionHealthy/park; #232 adds recovery gate and bounded host handshake. Snapshot code and compare #228→#232 inspected; no causal device claim.

Host SpeechRecognitionService.ensureSessionActive uses isSessionHealthy (isSessionActive && audioEngine.isRunning && activeSession identity). Keyboard's early reentry path still trusts persisted isRecording/isSessionActive before issuing bounded start handshake.

AVAudioSession input tap is installed once on session start; captureOwner enum gates tap-state acquisition, and Callback read/write uses an OSAllocatedUnfairLock. Same-enum stale endCapture remains R8 hypothesis deferred X7.

Current stopRecording releases capture then waits bounded 4s for live worker; if still decoding, preserves CAF and fails closed rather than start competing final decode. Speech workers counted until transcribe returns.

Cold Qwen finalization captures audio in FIFO before loading; suspendForModelLoad keeps intent without sending sessionEnded; defer checks same request token/cancellation and restores once when capture/playback/competing session absent.
restoreAfterModelLoad false gate is collapsed to nil; wrapper returns before audioSessionRestoreFailed, so diagnostic does not distinguish declined recovery from missing intent.

MicrophonePressPolicy can return startThenStop on a long release without hold activation; MicAnimatedButton.dispatchRelease ignores buttonActivated for this branch. Whether SwiftUI sends such a cancelled release is device-dependent.

SwiftUI timers for app max recording and idle audio auto-stop enqueue unscoped MainActor Task callbacks after scheduled Timer fires. Session epoch not captured; stale invocation after new session is hypothesis.

At default 16kHz Float32, 30 minutes would accumulate 28.8M samples = 115.2MB (~110MiB) before other model/file buffers; queue's default maximumUnreadSamples nil. No peak RAM measured; risk not classified observed OOM.

Realtime audio tap uses UserDefaults heartbeat approx 0.5s and level flush up to 30Hz, allocates converter buffers and writes CAF under callback lock. Actual glitches/latency not measured; examine throttled out-of-callback transport at X8 only if evidence.

LLM/model change guards, parked session manual end/cancel, temporary background task and token-scoped live update present. Native Task.detached decode not cancellable in-flight; generation checks stop stale model publication, not immediate native termination.

Explicit interrupted-in-flight cold Qwen restoration ordering, stale same-kind capture release (R8), and physical first-attempt Live RAM tolerance remain unverified; X7 cross-meeting/conversation ownership still pending.
No private text, audio, transcript, host bundle identifiers or credentials written into this review branch.
